svg.title: Repo constellations
svg.desc: A star map of smaller repositories grouped into constellations whose lines draw themselves. FastAPI patterns: fastapi_practices, fastapi_sql_aws_base. Frontend and 3D: Babylon_Vue, react-basics-rejuvenation, AngularInMemoryCompanyAdmin. Containers: flask_mongo_dockerized, heroku_deploy_flask. Tools: github-stats. A rotating spiral galaxy holds the DSA work: dsa_algo with 140 files and blind_leetcode_python with 53 problem files.
